# Data Examples

表格和复杂数据组件先定义列、数据和 key，再处理分页、选择、展开等增强项。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Countdown

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/countdown/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/countdown/`.

Note: `now` 只用于首屏/SSR；不传时服务端是 `00:00:00`，mount 后再算。`HH` 无 `D` 时是总小时。`ariaLabel` 打在根上，timer 名仍是时间。

Vue: `<Countdown :value="deadline" />`

React: `<Countdown value={deadline} />`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
